# Claude Code 2.1.332 model picker in short panes

Captured on macOS on 2026-11-26 from Elwood-started sessions with a private
`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, bypass permissions, the 14-row served catalog, Opus 5.5
current, and no model turns. The `disclosure-only` pair came from a
session without bypass permissions. Screens retain only the native dialog and remove
trailing blank cells.

- `one-row`: the opening window at 100x12, one model row over `↓ 5 more`.
- `one-row-scrolled`: a later window at 100x12, one model row between `↑ 6 more`
  and `↓ 8 more`. The disclosure, expanded and scrolled away, is counted in the 6.
- `one-row-disclosure`: the last collapsed window at 100x16, one model row beside the
  selected `More models` disclosure.
- `disclosure-only`: the window at 100x12 after five downs, holding only the selected,
  collapsed `More models` disclosure under `↑ 5 more`.
- `disclosure-only-expanded`: the same window after Enter, the expanded disclosure between
  `↑ 5 more` and `↓ 9 more`.
- `footer-cut`: the opening window at 100x10, whose hint row falls below the pane.
